import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

from io import StringIO
df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Create a comprehensive visualization with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Price vs Megapixels with brand colors
ax1 = axes[0, 0]
brands = df['brand'].unique()
colors = sns.color_palette('husl', n_colors=len(brands))
for i, brand in enumerate(brands):
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                label=brand, s=100, alpha=0.7, color=colors[i])
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Price vs Megapixels by Brand')
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Weight vs Price
ax2 = axes[0, 1]
scatter = ax2.scatter(df['weight_grams'], df['price_usd'], 
                      c=df['model_year'], s=150, alpha=0.7, cmap='viridis')
ax2.set_xlabel('Weight (grams)', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Weight vs Price (colored by Year)')
plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax2, label='Model Year')
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 3. Distribution of sensor types
ax3 = axes[0, 2]
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(range(len(sensor_counts)), sensor_counts.values, color=sns.color_palette('Set2'))
ax3.set_xticks(range(len(sensor_counts)))
ax3.set_xticklabels(sensor_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Distribution of Sensor Types')
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 4. Model Year timeline
ax4 = axes[1, 0]
ax4.scatter(df['model_year'], df['price_usd'], s=df['megapixels']*5, 
            alpha=0.6, c=range(len(df)), cmap='coolwarm')
for i, row in df.iterrows():
    ax4.annotate(row['brand'], (row['model_year'], row['price_usd']), 
                fontsize=8, alpha=0.7)
ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Price over Years (bubble size = megapixels)')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 5. Max ISO comparison
ax5 = axes[1, 1]
ax5.barh(df['brand'] + ' ' + df['model_year'].astype(str), df['max_iso'], 
         color=sns.color_palette('muted', n_colors=len(df)))
ax5.set_xlabel('Max ISO', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Maximum ISO by Camera')
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 6. Body Type and 4K Video
ax6 = axes[1, 2]
body_type_counts = df.groupby(['body_type', 'has_video_4k']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
body_type_counts.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax6, color=['#FF6B6B', '#4ECDC4'], alpha=0.8)
ax6.set_xlabel('Body Type', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count', fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Body Type Distribution (4K Video)')
ax6.legend(['No 4K', 'Has 4K'], title='4K Video')
ax6.set_xticklabels(ax6.get_xticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='y')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
